title: Cuppini 2011 · Peri-hand network tool training
citation: Cuppini, C., Magosso, E., & Ursino, M. (2011). Organization, maturation, and plasticity of multisensory integration: Insights from computational modeling studies. Frontiers in Psychology, 2, 77.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.plasticity: Apply Hebbian growth with upper saturation to feedforward visual connections in the trained hemisphere.
published_method.readout: Compare tactile activity in the trained region and the lateralized extinction simulation.

stimulus_type.value: Tactile and elongated visual training inputs followed by visuotactile test inputs
stimulus_type.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions

value.frame: Hand-centered receptive fields with predefined arrangement

source_provenance.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions
source_provenance.gap: Original implementation and some prior equations and numerical constants remain unavailable.

trajectory_count.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions
trajectory_count.gap: Independent spatial inputs. Figure comparisons vary locations.

training.tactile: Patch representing skin input while holding a tool
training.visual: Elongated, task-relevant field representing rake use

trajectory_path.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions

stimulus_duration.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions; Cuppini 2011, pp. 3, 10, 14 and References pp. 20–21
stimulus_duration.gap: The 2010a training equation holds touch from onset and specifies no finite offset. The approximately 400 ms run and 300 ms readout describe its assessment. The reviewed 2011 source does not report finite tactile-cue durations for training or post-training assessment, or a solver stopping rule.

stimulus_speed.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions
stimulus_speed.gap: Spatial samples replace a moving source.

value: Auditory comparison stays at basal configuration
auditory_conditions.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions

gain_envelope.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions
gain_envelope.gap: No physical audio waveform is generated.

dynamics.RF: Gaussian, auditory larger than visual or tactile
dynamics.feedforward_visual_auditory: Constant over the hand and exponentially decreasing outside
dynamics.feedback: Excitatory with the same arrangement as feedforward
dynamics.hemispheric_competition: A multimodal neuron drives inhibition of unimodal areas in the opposite hemisphere

renderer_or_apparatus.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions
renderer_or_apparatus.gap: Solver, code version, time step and phase-specific numerical constants unavailable. The earlier SC table has its own source scope.

value: Tactile plus elongated visual training input
trial_rows_families.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions

condition_intermixing.gap: Neural simulations have no human acquisition schedule or response device.

response_window.gap: Readout is approximately steady-state activity. Integration duration and tolerance unavailable.

inputs.tactile: Patch representing skin input while holding a tool
inputs.visual: Elongated, task-relevant field representing rake use

plasticity.changed: Feedforward synapses from active visual neurons to the left multimodal unit
plasticity.auditory: No presynaptic auditory activity during training

retest.unilateral: Repeat near and far right visuotactile input
retest.bilateral: Repeat left touch with right visual input at the illustrated distance grid
retest.auditory_retest: Not reported after training because auditory results are assumed to match pretraining.

value.findings: Visual input in the trained far region behaves as near input. In the RBD configuration both near and far right visual input can suppress left tactile-related activation.

task_sequence_rules.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions

tactile_stimulus.value: Right-hand two-patch training input. The cited 2010a training equation uses 3.6 model units in the active regions. The 2011 issue does not give a numerical input scale.
tactile_stimulus.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Fig. 12A; Magosso 2010a, si34.gif and si111.gif–si113.gif
tactile_stimulus.gap: The cited 2010a training equation has no finite offset. The 2011 implementation, exact training duration and post-training probe amplitudes remain unknown.

soa_table.source: Cuppini 2011, pp. 13–16, Network training and Peri-hand space representation after tool-use, Figs. 12–14; Cuppini 2011, pp. 16–19, Discussion and predictions
soa_table.gap: Concurrent inputs are described. No independent temporal-offset manipulation is reported.

implementation_gaps: A model solver is required to apply Hebbian learning and reproduce the paired inputs.
Exact 2011 training count, rate, thresholds and weight saturation are unresolved.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
